flag.\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022For each ranked vehicle, the comparison set is other ledger vehicles of the same model with a model year within one year and mileage within 15,000 as a red flag.\u0022,\u0022Tests pin the note for a case shaped like JTDBCMFEXS3070309 (17,289 dollars against late-model XLEs at about 22,000 to 24,000) and pin no note when the comparison set is too
